name: The Balnir Farmstead
summary: In eastern Tirisfal, snapdragons at the Balnir Farmstead may show how far the Scourge's corruption has spread. Anastasia Hartwell sends young Forsaken mages to gather them for study in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Magical Barometer
sections.body: Forsaken mages watch the borderlands for signs of magical corruption. Anastasia Hartwell sends novice spellcasters to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades to gather snapdragons from its gardens. The flowers absorb magical energies from the soil and air. By examining them, arcane scholars in the Undercity can judge whether corruption from the Lich King's domain has reached Tirisfal.

sections.title: The Eastern Border
sections.body: The Balnir Farmstead lies near the edge of the glades, close to the blighted wilderness of the Western Plaguelands. The Forsaken know the Lich King's plague rots the land, while Scourge corruption threatens their borders and security. The Forsaken wield dark arts of their own, but Anastasia plans to pass the snapdragons to the apothecaries for study. Mages and alchemists can examine the danger together and help defend Lordaeron's reclaimed heartland.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia Hartwell want snapdragons specifically?
faq.answer: Balnir snapdragons are sensitive to magical forces and absorb energy from the earth and air. Studying them can show Forsaken mages whether the Plaguelands' arcane and necromantic blight is reaching Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where is the Balnir Farmstead located?
faq.answer: The Balnir Farmstead lies in eastern Tirisfal Glades, near the border with the blighted Western Plaguelands. Snapdragons grow in the plots and gardens around its decrepit farm buildings.

Anastasia Hartwell is a Forsaken mage and trainer in the Undercity's Mage Quarter. She teaches newly risen undead casters discipline, arcane balance, and how to defend their borders against rival powers.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken mages care about stopping the plague?
faq.answer: The Forsaken see the Lich King's infectious scourge magic as uncontrolled, even as they experiment with plagues and blights of their own. Left unchecked, the Scourge could consume Tirisfal Glades and threaten Forsaken independence.

faq.q: What happens to the flowers after you collect them?
aliases: what does anastasia do with the flowers
faq.answer: Anastasia plans to pass the snapdragons to the Undercity's apothecaries. Alchemists and mages will examine them to learn how deeply the Scourge has tainted the soil and plants.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted to mages?
faq.answer: Yes. Anastasia offers this trial only to young Forsaken mages who have finished their first lessons in Deathknell and reached the capital to prove their grasp of arcane theory.

angles.text: As a mage, you learn early that arcane study can help watch for and defend against foreign magical corruption.
As Forsaken, you depend on keeping the Scourge from Tirisfal's borders to protect your survival and sovereignty.
As a herbalist, you see how a plant can hold traces of magical pollution and reveal its presence.
